Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Marketing Data Analyst to join our Marketing Operations & Events team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining reporting infrastructure that provides visibility into marketing program performance, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution, while also executing email marketing and landing page campaigns across North America and supporting the company’s global NRF annual event. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with hands-on marketing execution experience and the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, or a related data analysis role.
Advanced proficiency with Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
Strong SQL and data manipulation skills.
Experience pulling, transforming, and analyzing data from multiple business systems.
Ability to develop meaningful data visualizations and communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Marketo, HubSpot, or Eloqua.
Experience building, scheduling, and reporting on email marketing campaigns.
Experience managing and optimizing landing pages using platforms such as Instapage.
Proficiency with HTML and CSS for email and landing page development.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Reporting or CRM-related certification.
Experience with Salesforce reporting and CRM data structures.
Knowledge of marketing attribution models and campaign ROI methodologies.
Advanced Excel and Power Query skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience supporting executive-level reporting and presentations.
Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Willingness to travel up to 10% as needed.
Ability to support occasional time-sensitive reporting deadlines outside standard business hours.
The Marketing Data Analyst serves as a key contributor to the Marketing Operations & Events team by transforming marketing and sales data into meaningful reporting and recommendations. This position owns dashboard development and reporting processes, supports data integration initiatives, delivers analytical insights to leadership, and manages email marketing execution. Success in this role requires expertise in business intelligence tools, marketing technology platforms, data analysis, and campaign operations.
Key Responsibilities
Dashboard & Reporting Ownership
Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports that track marketing performance, campaign ROI, and pipeline contribution.
Design and develop Power BI dashboards and visualizations based on stakeholder requirements.
Ensure data accuracy and timely refreshes across reporting platforms.
Own the marketing analytics reporting calendar, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly leadership reporting.
Validate data integrity and troubleshoot reporting discrepancies.
Manage reporting access and permissions for Marketing Operations & Events team members.
Data Integration & Marketing Technology Partnership
Partner with Marketing Technology team members to maintain clean, reliable data flows between systems.
Identify and resolve data quality issues across CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms.
Support onboarding and integration of new marketing and sales data sources.
Maintain documentation of data definitions, reporting logic, and dashboard standards.
Assist with Power BI administration and reporting best practices.
Escalate and help resolve platform and data quality concerns.
Analysis & Insight Generation
Analyze campaign, program, and event performance data to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
Conduct ad hoc analysis in response to leadership and operational requests.
Translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Partner with event and campaign teams to evaluate marketing effectiveness and ROI.
Stakeholder Communication
Present reporting updates, dashboard insights, and analytical findings to marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Simplify complex data concepts into meaningful business recommendations.
Process & Documentation
Develop and maintain documentation for reporting processes, dashboard logic, governance standards, and data definitions.
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to reporting efficiency and consistency.
Email Marketing Execution
Build, schedule, and deploy email campaigns, nurture programs, operational emails, and newsletters.
Manage email calendars, audience segmentation, and list hygiene processes.
Ensure compliance with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and email deliverability best practices.
Maintain and update email templates in partnership with brand and web teams.
Coordinate event-related registration, confirmation, and follow-up communications.
Monitor and report on email performance metrics, including opens, clicks, and conversions.
Administrative & Team Support
Assist with reporting tool licenses, documentation, and access management.
Provide cross-functional support during periods of increased workload or priority initiatives.
Perform other duties as assigned.
This position does not directly manage a budget; however, the reporting, dashboards, and analytical insights generated by this role directly influence marketing investment decisions, campaign optimization strategies, and budget allocation across the Marketing Operations & Events organization.
This position works across multiple marketing systems and stakeholder groups, translating varied and often ambiguous business requests into accurate, actionable reporting. Success requires strong technical expertise, data analysis capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights clearly to non-technical audiences while managing recurring deadlines and competing priorities.

About Vercel:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.
About the Role:
The next generation of software won’t just be used by people — it’ll be built and shipped by agents. Builds are where that happens, and they’re the beating heart of Vercel. Whether an idea starts in v0, in an agent, or in an engineer’s editor, every customer builds — and millions of builds flow through our systems every day.
As an engineer on the Agentic Infrastructure team, you’ll take ownership of the systems that carry that work at scale. You won’t just contribute features — you’ll be responsible for the design, reliability, and evolution of the platform itself. You’ll make decisions that shape performance, define best practices, and ensure the workflows that Vercel, our customers, and their agents depend on are fast, resilient, and secure.
This role blends product thinking with deep systems ownership. You’ll partner with teams across Vercel to build and operate the agentic infrastructure that determines how software actually ships.
We’re looking for engineers who want to own high-scale systems end-to-end, thrive on improving the developer/agent experience, and are driven to have a lasting impact on how modern software gets built and delivered.
What You Will Do:
Own and evolve the infrastructure that powers Vercel’s build and deployment lifecycle — from handling webhooks to designing resilient database schemas and building scalable APIs.
Design and operate high-performance microservices that process millions of builds daily, ensuring speed, reliability, and developer delight.
Lead projects end-to-end: from identifying opportunities to defining technical direction and delivering improvements in performance, reliability, and developer experience.
Collaborate across teams to align infrastructure with company-wide goals and ensure seamless developer workflows.
Shape the long-term vision of agentic infrastructure at Vercel by setting standards for scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.
Participate in the on-call rotation, taking responsibility for the reliability of critical systems.
Contribute to the open-source community, representing Vercel’s commitment to advancing developer tools globally.
Write clean, efficient, tested, and well-documented code that others can build upon confidently.
About You:
3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating backend applications and distributed systems at scale.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to navigate and improve complex systems.
Strong proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
A track record of end-to-end ownership — from design and implementation through to long-term operation in production.
Skilled at cross-team collaboration, able to influence priorities and drive alignment toward shared goals.
Able to reason about technical direction and architectural tradeoffs, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
Invested in the people around you — through mentorship, code review, or simply raising the bar on how the team builds.
Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to push the boundaries of how modern software gets built and shipped.
Bonus If You:
Are familiar with React or Next.js
Have experience with DynamoDB
Have worked to develop a CI/CD platform or internal developer platform used by other engineers or by agents.
Have experience contributing to, or participating in open-source projects.
Have experience optimizing build systems for monorepos or polyrepo setups.
Have experience with build caching, artifact storage, or dependency management at scale.
Benefits & Compensation:
Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.
The base pay range for this role is $196,000.00 - $294,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.
